g.title: j3084900978
g.text: Ah... it is an uncomfortable subject, oui ? Pardon, but I do not know quite how to speak of it, without twisting myself into a knot.

g.title: j1751384135
g.text: I believe Lyon would take his own life before harming me. I have all faith, in all the gods, and devils -

g.title: j3744429094
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j1354224235
g.text: The nightmares that fill his mind - Lua guides him on a difficult path, oui ?

g.title: j3156166748
g.text: But I will do my best. I assume you ask out of concern for him ?

g.title: j695453305
g.text: - that not even your Indifférence could trick him to raise a hand to me in violence.

g.title: j852445032
g.text: [This will route around all conversations regarding self-harm.]

g.title: j2345696447
g.text: It is a hard thing, I fear, to speak of. For I know it is something that should not be, oui ?

g.title: j2577092450
g.text: The Warframe that he was given the serum to is known to... well...

g.title: j924224451
g.text: It's fairly obvious from looking at him... no offense. It wasn't hard to guess.

g.title: j1539029949
g.text: I might fear a butterfly would devour me whole, before I would I fear the brother of my soul.

g.title: j921763853
g.text: I should wish to stop him. To protect him from this desire of his to do himself such harm.

g.title: j3987984754
g.text: I'm just concerned he might take it too far some day.

g.title: j1861966150
g.text: We need him in one piece.

g.title: j1322177790
g.text: I don't need to be worrying about having to clean up his corpse.

g.title: j3617966760
g.text: If there is one thing I know of Lyon to be certain, it is that he will always be there when he is needed.

g.title: j2885424238
g.text: You echo the words of the devil. Is it only callous need of capable hands that inspires you ?

g.title: j698283448
g.text: Dégoûtant.

g.title: j271651691
g.text: He is the great protector, le bouclier sacré de Lua.... The shining light in the darkness of the night.

g.title: j3904998582
g.text: No, I care about him a great deal. I just am worried when we need him, he won't be there.

g.title: j1213995479
g.text: I just need to know if I can count on him or not, or if he's already too broken.

g.title: j1508231473
g.text: Boolean MarieNoDate is now true.

g.title: j3265199910
g.text: The pain he inflicts upon himself... he does to hear his own thoughts. To feel his own body.

g.title: j224761853
g.text: I wonder who will help you, when you are laid low and are in need of a hand.

g.title: j2490481427
g.text: For the sky is filled with stars, and each of them whisper to him, and he, like Lua herself, would be lost among them.

g.title: j3573198734
g.text: Or do you believe that time has already come and gone, and now you are above such reproach ?

g.title: j3039211523
g.text: And like Lua, he goes through his phases. He becomes consumed by the Void only to shine so bright that we all may walk in darkness without fear.

g.title: j1722267735
g.text: But like all blessings, it comes with a curse. Do I make any sense ? I fear I am only rambling.

g.title: j440331003
g.text: I understand completely. And I have... a bit of a confession to make. [Confess feelings for Lyon.]

g.title: j194541017
g.text: I understand what you're saying, but I can't condone him hurting himself. He should stop.

g.title: j1891302186
g.text: [Warning: Discussion of suicide.] I lost someone once, to that kind of self-harm. I can't... I can't condone it.

g.title: j3713074438
g.text: There has to be another way.

g.title: j238055324
g.text: You're making perfect sense. I just... wish I could help him.

g.title: j3720581387
g.text: Boolean DrifterLyon is now true.

g.title: j3077121718
g.text: Boolean DrifterHarmStop is now true.

g.title: j3212085058
g.text: Boolean DrifterHarmLoss is now true.

g.title: j3294200700
g.text: Boolean DrifterHarmHelp is now true.

g.title: j3863013961
g.text: I fear he's... taken hold of my heart, and it breaks to know he's in pain.

g.title: j2937961672
g.text: The pain he feels is deeper than what he inflicts upon his flesh. What he does to himself now he can no longer fall from.

g.title: j3192074471
g.text: Oh ! I did not know, I am so very, very sorry... What pathetic manner of platitudes and prayers I could offer you would feel empty I am certaine -

g.title: j3213533487
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j2109742011
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j75450057
g.text: It clears his mind, steadies his soul. And now, as a protoframe - as partly this... Harrow, as I am partly Wisp, it will not kill him, oui ?

g.title: j4169858727
g.text: - for what condoléances could someone you barely know give, that could serve as a balm to a tragédie such as that ?

g.title: j1694485209
g.text: And for this, I cannot adore you more. But the form help takes can be many things, non ?

g.title: j2270178547
g.text: Oh !! I have just screamed like I have seen a mouse and startled Monsieur Loid ! Pardon !!

g.title: j2700012876
g.text: No, it won't kill him. But it's still not okay.

g.title: j3495345274
g.text: I guess I see your point.

g.title: j4163368191
g.text: This soul you lost of which you speak... were they close to you ?

g.title: j1066131446
g.text: To help a baby bird may be to kill it. To help a candle flame may be to blow it out in your exubérance.

g.title: j3066916057
g.text: Oh, but this is such wonderful news !

g.title: j2850845031
g.text: I have found that being beside him when he needs me... listening to him, holding him when he weeps ?

g.title: j3483575256
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j4183777516
g.text: Yes.

g.title: j352490053
g.text: Not very.

g.title: j2083780586
g.text: I have found that being beside him when he needs me... listening to him, merely sitting beside him when he weeps ?

g.title: j2516224401
g.text: Really? I didn't know how you'd feel about it.

g.title: j2925508944
g.text: I just wish I could tell if he could stand my presence or not...

g.title: j4162944384
g.text: Does more for him than speaking of what he should and should not do.

g.title: j2597183280
g.text: Is this why you seek to ensure that Lyon does not befall the same fate ? Or is it simply the topic itself that upsets you ?

g.title: j3349548751
g.text: Even still, to have someone near to you feel so trapped within their context that there was only one manner of escape...

g.title: j3299974639
g.text: Does more for him than speaking of what he should and should not do.

g.title: j1242140555
g.text: Oh, am I overjoyed. Tellement ravie ! Lyon is in such need of love - you do not know !

g.title: j709186702
g.text: Ah, like talking to a statue de marbre, non ? I know how you feel. I have oft found myself twenty minutes deep in a story only to realize he was not listening.

g.title: j3715000454
g.text: You must learn to read between the lines, non ? He speaks in stories. In paraboles. If he is silent, listen to his actions.

g.title: j330412388
g.text: I... need to just avoid the topic, please. I can't.

g.title: j236015647
g.text: I need to be certain that Lyon doesn't suffer...

g.title: j2753656757
g.text: I'll do what I can to take your advice. I just don't know how to get through to him.

g.title: j477029940
g.text: I'll do what I can, I just... I wish I could do more.

g.title: j3355993537
g.text: He can just be... frustrating.

g.title: j384785145
g.text: Ah, but perhaps you do. He is, as you can tell, in such pain, despite appearances...

g.title: j3338146859
g.text: Lost in the hallways of his mind again or paying attention to some other esprit in the room.

g.title: j118949634
g.text: Be patient with him, be kind, et je vous en supplie, do not hurt him, oui ?

g.title: j3236681551
g.text: Boolean LyonPainOff is now true.

g.title: j2242346858
g.text: Boolean LyonPainResolved is now true.

g.title: j3890621154
g.text: Ah, like talking to a statue de marbre, non ? I know how you feel. I have oft found myself twenty minutes deep in a story only to realize he was not listening.

g.title: j2863319301
g.text: Oui, I understand. But there is sometimes little that we can do. But to be there for others when and how they wish for us to be there for them.

g.title: j1831063408
g.text: Be patient with him, be kind, et je vous en supplie, do not hurt him, oui ?

g.title: j226983447
g.text: You must learn to read between the lines, non ? He speaks in stories. In paraboles. If he is silent, listen to his actions.

g.title: j100204758
g.text: I still don't think it's right.

g.title: j179271212
g.text: I'll do what I can.

g.title: j2324638135
g.text: Of course... Can I tell you a story of someone I knew, who did the same ? Or would you rather we go our separate ways ?

g.title: j3560285075
g.text: Lost in the hallways of his mind again or paying attention to some other esprit in the room.

g.title: j2622530617
g.text: To do more would be to crush them or drive them away.

g.title: j556576556
g.text: That is all I ask. Oh, but I am so overjoyed ! I must work to make this pairing come to pass !

g.title: j1497579067
g.text: Then speak to him of your concern. He will listen. He is no child.

g.title: j1679144985
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j2818058620
g.text: Let's end this here.

g.title: j606841234
g.text: Can we get back to talking about Lyon, instead?

g.title: j380763417
g.text: I... think I'd like to hear about them.

g.title: j1876174374
g.text: You must learn to read between the lines, non ? He speaks in stories. In paraboles. If he is silent, listen to his actions.

g.title: j3893268794
g.text: But you care, you wish to help him - and I am certain he knows this. Ah ! Here it is. He is like a stray dog, with a scar upon his leg. It is healed, but healed wrong. So it hurts him still, and itches.

g.title: j2691444140
g.text: Wait, I didn't mean for you to meddle!

g.title: j2012327477
g.text: Should I be concerned?

g.title: j500264666
g.text: I could use the help.

g.title: j3341850571
g.text: He is like a stray dog, with a scar upon his leg. It is healed, but healed wrong. So it hurts him still, and itches.

g.title: j3702887446
g.text: Merci. That is all I can ask. À bientôt.

g.title: j1739544052
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j146060101
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j2767069790
g.text: Check boolean MarieBackstory1

g.title: j393734537
g.text: He chews upon the leg, and though it opens the wound and brings him pain, it also brings him relief.

g.title: j2063395929
g.text: Hah ! It is too late for that now. Marie, au travail ! Il y a de l'amour dans l'air !

g.title: j3029107285
g.text: Oui ! And you could not stop me, even if you wished. Marie, to work !

g.title: j2712603609
g.text: Oui, of course. À bientôt.

g.title: j1218675272
g.text: Oui, of course.

g.title: j2160104456
g.text: You know how my story begins, but there is a portion I did not tell you.

g.title: j2767069790->j2160104456
g.text: true

g.title: j4075045359
g.text: Boolean MarieBackstory1 is now true.

g.title: j2767069790->j4075045359
g.text: false

g.title: j3467889267
g.text: It harms him, but it is part of him, all the same. And if you approach him avec colère, if you are harsh, he will flinch from your touch.

g.title: j3215365687
g.text: I told you that I was a beggar upon the streets, when I was a jeune fille. And that I did well for myself and that I had many friends.

g.title: j1629616535
g.text: I was born into a rich famille, which might surprise you. The bourgeois class, who are closer to the Orokin than not.

g.title: j876309799
g.text: You must earn the trust of the stray. Let him come to you, non ? Does this make sense ?

g.title: j1748436498
g.text: One of them was a big older boy named Hugo.

g.title: j2203108009
g.text: But when I was born as I was... deformed, with mes pieds tordus et inutilisables ? Oh, ma mère could not have that.

g.title: j3453866154
g.text: Yes, actually. Thank you.

g.title: j300697660
g.text: More than it should, thank you.

g.title: j2066845263
g.text: None. But thanks for trying.

g.title: j70446094
g.text: He was a bit of the leader of the pack. And he always made sure no one picked on me and I had all I needed.

g.title: j4243668126
g.text: There were appearances to be maintained, oui ? Standards to be kept.

g.title: j1936013595
g.text: Bien ! I was afraid I let my metaphors get away from me again.

g.title: j309157818
g.text: Marie and her metaphors. Ah, bon.

g.title: j3920185405
g.text: Mince alors. I knew I let my métaphores get away from me again.

g.title: j755093854
g.text: He even helped me build des béquilles - you might call them... eh... crutches ? That I could use to drag myself about, with bits of wood we scavenged.

g.title: j4030106854
g.text: So, what was to be done, with poor malformed Marie ? I was brought to la Cité de la Lumière, where certainly I would perish upon the streets...

g.title: j4141824820
g.text: Hm. It occurs to me that perhaps describing Lyon as a stray dog is not the most flattering comparison to make...

g.title: j444454361
g.text: One morning, we went to go wake him, and we found him -

g.title: j3249245483
g.text: And abandoned to die.

g.title: j4071503027
g.text: Perhaps do not tell him I did so, oui...?

g.title: j2467433727
g.text: Je... I will spare you the details... I am certain you can guess.

g.title: j449803405
g.text: How old were you?

g.title: j3244835412
g.text: Your family left you for dead?

g.title: j1672678032
g.text: Boolean LyonStrayDog is now true.

g.title: j332158405
g.text: But he left us a note. It was barely legible. He was the only one of the other children who knew his letters, and I had to read it to the others.

g.title: j3605099945
g.text: Six ? Seven ? In their eyes, they had tried their best to mend me for many years. Tutors to teach me to walk. Braces. Footwear.

g.title: j304469797
g.text: In their eyes, they had tried their best to mend me for many years. Tutors to teach me to walk. Braces. Footwear.

g.title: j2406238482
g.text: I think it's adorable, and so will he.

g.title: j1764251822
g.text: Your secret is safe with me.

g.title: j2680976435
g.text: I remember still how my voice choked. But I had to stay strong. Because even then, I knew that I had a duty to the others.

g.title: j2024578280
g.text: They were tired of the burden. So, barely able to even read and write my numbers and letters, I found myself in the muck.

g.title: j758510050
g.text: Quelle horrible personne ! J'espère que votre chaise va s'effondrer et vous donner plein d'échardes douloureuses !

g.title: j2176802145
g.text: Merci ! What a relief...

g.title: j1429181606
g.text: Hugo had always seemed so happy to us, they said to me. Si joyeux. Always meeting life with a laugh and a sneer.

g.title: j513960459
g.text: That's horrible.

g.title: j2304556691
g.text: How did you survive?

g.title: j1331965247
g.text: Even when we were chased away or he was beaten with a stick for theft or loitering, it did not seem to bother him.

g.title: j714426695
g.text: Check boolean MarieSecretPower

g.title: j2319753297
g.text: But we never know the depth of the pain others feel in their hearts. And in that letter, I knew he wept with Lua.

g.title: j1081268672
g.text: It was like you said, non ? All inconveniences come with a secret power.

g.title: j714426695->j1081268672
g.text: true

g.title: j591496065
g.text: What made me indésirable pour ma mère, made me quite popular amongst the other children of the streets.

g.title: j714426695->j591496065
g.text: false

g.title: j3979586789
g.text: But that he was now at peace at her side. For a time, I resented him for leaving. For the others looked to me for guidance. And I resented him for abandoning me.

g.title: j1401401528
g.text: What is more pathétique than a child with no pieds, oui ? I could earn more in a day with open palms than they could rob in a week.

g.title: j1488469813
g.text: But over time, I came to understand the truth of it.

g.title: j2967129488
g.text: And I was always wont to share. So I had many friends who would look out for me, take care of me. One of them was a big older boy named Hugo.

g.title: j2805502834
g.text: We can only forgive ourselves for being human. And forgive ourselves the pain of their leaving.

g.title: j1312292554
g.text: For it is their absence that hurts us. And the thought that we could not do more to aid them.

g.title: j4249515968
g.text: The burdens that others carry are never ours to know.

g.title: j3218773287
g.text: And that is a great tragédie. But it is what it means to be human.

g.title: j1775613711
g.text: I do not know if this story aided you. But I can only pray that it did. I must go, Monsieur Loid is calling.

g.title: j1849472471
g.text: Thank you, Marie.

g.title: j1316993605
g.text: [Stay silent.]

g.title: j2680064601
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j3386425480
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j3518898325
g.text: You are most welcome. À bientôt.

g.title: j1123121321
g.text: À la revoyure.
